headline: BYD plans to buy a French car factory from Ineos Automotive
summary: BYD has started exclusive negotiations to acquire the car manufacturing plant in Hambach, France, operated by Ineos Automotive.
why: BYD is a Chinese electric vehicle and battery maker that is expanding its manufacturing footprint abroad. Acquiring an existing European factory would give it local production capacity in the EU.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: BYD would take on a European factory through the proposed acquisition, adding production capacity and capital commitments.
